text.en: Breaking an enemy shield transfers one bullet from reserves. Breaking a combatant shield—or the shield of a Guardian using a Super—with that shield's energy type grants bonus damage for the rest of the magazine.

Breaking an elemental shield matching the currently selected element <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine from reserves and grants 5 shots of 'Ionic Return'.

Ionic Return grants each shot the following benefits:
• 15% increased bodyshot damage
• 37% increases critical damage
